title: Hydro Cooled Venezuelan Kiwifruit Ceviche
description: A fermented and refreshing Venezuelan dish featuring kiwifruit, perfect for adventurous eaters, this recipe is fodmap friendly and served in a mason jar. The ice bath shock helps to preserve the bouncy texture of the kiwifruit.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the diced kiwifruit, lime juice, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Let it sit at room temperature for 2 hours to allow fermentation.
Add the thinly sliced red onion and chopped cilantro to the bowl and mix gently.
Grate the ginger over the mixture and stir well.
Prepare an ice bath by filling a large container with ice and water.
Submerge a mason jar in the ice bath to cool it down.
Fill the cooled mason jar with the kiwifruit mixture and seal it.
Let it sit in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the hydro cooled Venezuelan kiwifruit ceviche chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
